groups.title: Machine-readable project map of the game's areas, validators and risks (Korean notes)

risks.text: It is a hand-kept description of other files; when you move or rename files in src/, tests/ or workflows, its file lists go stale and nothing checks them

groups.title: Working agreement for how code under src/ is organised (state, areas, tests, style)

risks.text: REWRITE.md is the rulebook for src/; changing a convention in code without updating it leaves newcomers following wrong rules

groups.title: CI workflows: verify (M1 + 2D battle tests), full npm test, and M2 verify with run-bound evidence

risks.text: m2-verify.yml only runs on pushes to the m2 branch and fails if m2_ci_*_verification_result.json files are tracked in git; never commit those result files
test.yml needs Chromium (npx playwright install) and uploads test-results/; a missing browser makes checks NOT_TESTED, not PASS

groups.title: 3D battle (M2) runtime: fixed-tick simulation, formations, morale, results and a three.js renderer

risks.text: m2 must stay independent of the main game: m2_verify fails if any m2 file mentions localStorage, ArsSaveService, GameClock, ArsGameState, uses requestAnimationFrame( or imports a remote URL
Four files (M2_BattleSnapshot, M2_CombatProfiles, M2_SpatialGrid, fixtures/m2_technical_fixture_v1) are pinned by git blob hash; any edit fails m2_verify until the hash is deliberately updated
Per-tick order in M2_BattleRuntime (damage, morale, result, render snapshot, markTick) is checked by source position; reordering breaks M21-03-STATIC-PHASES
M2_Bootstrap may expose only window.ArsM2Battle and window.ArsM2Diagnostics
Soldier models are loaded from assets/models/*.glb at runtime; if loading fails the game falls back to box soldiers with only a console warning

groups.title: Entry pages (index, battle2d, m2_prototype), verify scripts, package and test config

risks.text: index.html must load exactly one module, src/main.js; verify.mjs fails on missing scripts, inline scripts or absolute paths
m2_prototype.html must have a single script, m2/M2_Bootstrap.js, and an import map pointing 'three' at vendor/three/r184
m2_verify.mjs writes m2_verification_result.json into the working directory when run
Browser tests need Chromium (set PW_CHROMIUM_PATH for a local one); without it checks are NOT_TESTED, not passed

groups.title: App entry that wires browser storage, the world and battle starters into the UI

risks.text: main.js only passes storage and battle functions into mountApp; the 2D battle is imported lazily, so a broken battle2d module surfaces only when a battle starts

groups.title: 2D battle: seeded simulation (sim/) and canvas/HUD session (ui/), also run standalone from battle2d.html

risks.text: Simulation randomness must come only from sim/random.js (seeded); outcomes use one stream and visual effects a separate cosmetic stream so drawing never changes a fight
A seed must be a finite number; normalizeSeed throws otherwise
The session reports the battle end exactly once and dispose() must remove everything it added

groups.title: Shared basics: the single state store, results (ok/fail), seeded rng, calendar, ids, hashing

risks.text: State changes only inside store.transact(label, change); a failure result or throw discards the whole draft, and nested transactions fail
State must be plain JSON (no Map, Set, Date, classes); read it frozen via getState()

groups.title: Game areas (characters, finance, politics, settlements, world...) as pure rule modules on a state draft

risks.text: Rules take a draft and return ok()/fail('area_reason'); callers must return a failure unchanged so the whole transaction rolls back, and failure codes are stable once written
Other areas import an area only through its index.js; index.js registers the area's checks with registerAreaCheck
No Math.random, Date.now or window/DOM in rules; use draw(draft.rng) and draft.calendar
Changing a world record shape requires a conversion step in src/persist for old saves
Daily steps run in 'order' (ties by name) and one failing step fails the whole day

groups.title: Campaign actions, daily processing, new-game state and the areas map

risks.text: new-game.js holds SCHEMA_VERSION and the state shape; bumping it breaks saving/loading unless persist is updated
Daily processing runs each ended day through the ordered steps; failure fails the whole day

groups.title: Saving, loading, schema validation and conversion of v1 saves in browser storage

risks.text: Saves are written to a staging key, read back and verified before replacing the final key (ars_bellum_save_v2); keep this order
The v1 save key (ars_bellum_save_v1) is read and converted but must never be changed or deleted
A save from a newer schemaVersion is refused and never overwritten; a stale revision is refused too (save_conflict, save_older_than_stored)
Saves carry a sha256 digest of canonical JSON, so any change to state encoding invalidates existing saves

groups.title: Screens (menu, world map, settlement panel, battle flow) that draw state and send actions to the campaign

risks.text: UI gets storage and the battle starter as arguments to mountApp and must not reach for globals
Player-facing error text is mapped from failure codes in messages.js (Korean); a new failure code needs a message there
Browser storage may be unavailable (private mode); app handles it as storage_unavailable

groups.title: Unit (node:test), browser (Playwright) tests, fixtures, and the run-all harness driven by checks.json

risks.text: tests/checks.json is the one list of required checks; a listed id without a result or a result without a listed id fails npm test
Each test title must start with its check id in brackets and the id must be listed in checks.json
tests/fixtures/v1-new-game-save.json is a real v1 save used for migration tests; do not regenerate it

groups.title: Blender/Python scripts that build and slim the soldier models in assets/models

risks.text: slim_glb.py rewrites animations of a .glb and its own check() fails if motion differs beyond tolerance; run it standalone: python slim_glb.py model.glb
Output .glb files in assets/models are loaded by m2 at runtime; regenerate them rather than hand-editing

groups.title: Vendored three.js r184 (minified build and add-ons), loaded locally with no network

risks.text: Vendored and minified: do not edit; files are listed with size and sha256 in MANIFEST.json and runtime network import is false

rules.rule: All persistent game state is changed only inside store.transact so failures roll back
Code under src/ must not depend on the old root game files
Rules use draw(draft.rng) and draft.calendar, never Math.random or Date.now
Other areas import a domain only through its index.js
Never overwrite or delete the v1 save key; refuse to overwrite a newer-version save
A record shape change needs a matching save-conversion step in src/persist
Every test name starts with its bracketed check id, listed in tests/checks.json
m2 must not use localStorage, requestAnimationFrame or remote imports, and keeps pinned file hashes
Do not commit m2_ci_*_verification_result.json run evidence
Browser checks that were not run are NOT_TESTED, never recorded as PASS
